content.value: On a 250V supply ,a fault having a resistance of 20Ω develops between the unearthed end of the winding of an electric heater and the frame. If the resistance of the substation earth electrode is 4Ω that of human body 2000Ω and the state maximum current through the body is 25mA, what is the safe maximum resistance of consumer's earth electrode?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
